done_when: A pull request that changes only a test file runs that test file and no unrelated Linux or Windows groups

known.title: Preserve Windows coverage for shared fixtures inside test modules

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a pull request edits a shared fixture defined in a test module.
The filename check classifies shared fixture modules as independent test files. For example, `tests/test_close.py:260` defines `env`, imported by `tests/test_review_record_reuses_parent_tests.py:11`, whose consuming test is platform-marked at line 40. Because `test_close.py` has no platform marker, changing that fixture produces `test-only=true` and `run-windows=false`, skipping all affected Windows tests. This contradicts the recorded requirement to retain coverage for shared fixtures and dependencies. Preserve the full-run fallback for shared fixture modules, or include their affected platform consumers. The same classifier appears in `src/forge/templates/review-tests.py:28`.
findings.title: Preserve Windows coverage for shared fixtures inside test modules

why: A pull request that changes only one test file runs all six Linux test groups and all five Windows groups, about 30 minutes of checks for one test
